gloss: to reel in; to turn (pages); to count off one by one

definitions.gloss: to reel in; to turn over one by one; to count off in order
definitions.explanation: To move something along one length or one layer at a time with the hands — pulling in a rope hand over hand, flipping through the pages of a book or calendar, or ticking off days and items in order. The shared image is steady, unit-by-unit handling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧{繰|く}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She is slowly reeling in the thread.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}って⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I leafed through the dictionary and looked up the meaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指折|ゆびお}り→指折り：18050_yubiori⟧⟦{数|かぞ}えていた→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother turned the calendar pages and counted on her fingers the days until her grandchild would come.

notes:
A somewhat literary godan verb. Note that it is a homophone of ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (to come) in the dictionary form only — the conjugations differ completely ({繰|く}らない vs ⟦{来|こ}ない→来る：00254_kuru⟧).

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive; the thing handled takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}る, ⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}る.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}る: to turn the pages
- ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}る: to leaf through a dictionary
- ⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}る: to reel thread
- ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}る: to count off the days

SIMILAR WORDS:
- めくる: to turn over, to flip — the everyday word for turning pages; {繰|く}る sounds more bookish
- ⟦{手繰|たぐ}る→手繰る：30734_taguru⟧: to pull in hand over hand — keeps only the rope-pulling sense, and is used figuratively of tracing memories
